what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Israel, as counted by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 31382 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence.
Few people from Israel are refugees abroad; small numbers live in the United Kingdom, Germany, Canada and Spain.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Palestine territory in Israel in several periods, most recently from 2021 to 2025 with Hamas, PIJ, Fatah and the Palestinian Mujahideen Movement.
It also records armed conflict over Southern Lebanon territory with Hezbollah in 2006 and from 2023 to 2025, and wildfires are the disasters recorded for Israel in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's year-end figure was 200000 in 2023, the main year of displacement in the data.
It was lower in 2024 and again at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
